text:
Which change is occurring in a nucleus during β-emission?
A
An electron and a neutron become one proton.
B
An electron and a proton become one neutron.
C
A neutron becomes one proton and one electron.
D
A proton becomes one neutron and one electron.

options.label: A
options.text: An electron and a neutron become one proton.

options.label: B
options.text: An electron and a proton become one neutron.

options.label: C
options.text: A neutron becomes one proton and one electron.

options.label: D
options.text: A proton becomes one neutron and one electron.
